After the 63-turn scripted 3B replay plus the crossing turn, that diff finds nothing. Also add a checker rule in check_three_c_probe.py: for carried rows, a row with story_complete true and no recorded 3C chain commits is an error ('carried row recorded no reveals'). Then re-run the dry run: `.venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/three_c_probe.py --n 1 --dry-run --start carried --arms pump,families --semantic on --out bench/results/stage7-3c-carried-dry` (delete the dir first) and the checker with --mode dry.
